needs.what: The frame rate the game was tested at is not applied (nxnative writes the engine's frame limit or steps the game by the host's vsyncs); the game runs at its own rate.

nxnative gives this game a 3.00 GB heap region (nxweb: 1.50 GB); a game that sizes its heap from the memory pool it is told about will ask for more than a 4 GB WebAssembly memory can map (the pool nxweb reports would have to be smaller; not tried).
